title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question meets nearly every criterion: it says why it exists (an open pull request already partly does this work), it gives what each option leads to, it names a recommended option and the default, and it stays just under 120 words.
Minor slip on the task summary: 'the link from the accounts page' never says what the link points to, and the panel holding the credentials is only implied.
Minor jargon slip: 'merges' and 'project thread' are used without explanation. 'Pull request' is at least written out in full and no ids or branch names appear.
Each option says what happens to the reader: one change to review, waiting until the other work lands, or duplicate work where one version gets thrown away.
